p.src: The two episodes differ on one practical question: who receives durable access first, and whether that access survives stress.

u.src: The two episodes differ on one practical question: who receives durable access first, and whether that access survives stress.
en: The two episodes differ on one practical question: who receives durable access first, and whether that access survives stress.

p.src: Use this four-slot audit before adding ownership exposure in any environment.

u.src: Use this four-slot audit before adding ownership exposure in any environment.
en: Use this four-slot audit before adding ownership exposure in any environment.

p.src: 1) If A, B, and C are improving and reversibility remains healthy, add ownership in predefined tranches.

u.src: 1) If A, B, and C are improving and reversibility remains healthy, add ownership in predefined tranches.
en: 1) If A, B, and C are improving and reversibility remains healthy, add ownership in predefined tranches.

p.src: 2) If A improves but B does not, treat the period as transmission-first and keep defensive posture.

u.src: 2) If A improves but B does not, treat the period as transmission-first and keep defensive posture.
en: 2) If A improves but B does not, treat the period as transmission-first and keep defensive posture.

p.src: 3) If B and C improve but A is mixed, keep exposure fixed until signal direction confirms.

u.src: 3) If B and C improve but A is mixed, keep exposure fixed until signal direction confirms.
en: 3) If B and C improve but A is mixed, keep exposure fixed until signal direction confirms.

p.src: The 1973–74 oil-shock period fits high constraint persistence with mixed signals, so ownership scaling should be delayed.

u.src: The 1973–74 oil-shock period fits high constraint persistence with mixed signals, so ownership scaling should be delayed.
en: The 1973–74 oil-shock period fits high constraint persistence with mixed signals, so ownership scaling should be delayed.

p.src: The 1946–1951 period fits a cleaner A–B–C progression in several channels, so controlled scaling is more defensible.
